title: Continua, arcs and cut points
description: Locally connected continua with complete proofs: connected open sets are path connected, every path contains an arc, first Čech cohomology of a compact metric space by finite covers, and the theorem that a Peano continuum of dimension at most one with vanishing first Čech cohomology is a dendrite and has cut points, which is the last step of OpenAI's proof (2026) of the Singer conjecture in dimension four outside the middle degree.

units.title: First Čech cohomology of a compact metric space

prerequisites: core course Point-Set Topology (C90): compactness, connectedness, complete metric spaces
covering dimension: Definition 2.1 and Theorems 3.2, 4.2 of the lesson Covering dimension and finite trivializing covers (course Index theory of elliptic operators)
the course proves every other fact it uses
